name: PubMed
notes: NCBI Entrez E-utilities. Good for papers, reviews, clinical findings, mechanisms, and translational science.

name: ClinicalTrials.gov
notes: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2. Good for trial status changes, phases, sponsors, indications, and enrollment signals.

name: FDA / openFDA
notes: openFDA drug endpoints. Good for approvals, labels, recalls, and safety/regulatory context.

name: Nature Biotechnology
notes: Nature Portfolio RSS. Good for research and biotech trend scanning.

name: BioPharma Dive
notes: Industry news RSS. Good for deals, clinical milestones, pharma strategy, and commercial signals.

name: Fierce Biotech / Fierce Pharma
notes: Industry news RSS. Good for biotech financing, deals, layoffs, clinical and commercial news.

name: BioSpace
notes: Company news, hiring, financing, and press release flow.

name: 丁香园 / Insight
notes: Recommended for China medical/pharma context. Needs authorized API, account-based access, or compliant scraper.

name: 药明康德
notes: Official WuXi AppTec public pages are integrated: company news and media coverage. Investor relations, exchange announcements, and earnings pages can be added later.

name: 医药魔方 ByDrug
notes: Public ByDrug homepage SSR data is integrated for latest news and public reports. Deep database/API access still needs authorization and data contract.

name: 企业财报
notes: Recommended sources: SEC EDGAR for US-listed companies, HKEX/SSE/SZSE for China/HK, and company IR pages.
